title: Transport a prescribed splitting through an affine root-cover isomorphism
statement: Let p:Y to Spec R, g in R, n,d natural numbers, S a commutative ring, phi:R to S with phi(g) a unit. Put A=R[T]/(T^n-g), q:Spec A to Spec R and V=D(algebraMap R A g). Given e:Spec S isomorphic to V with e;inclusion;q=Spec phi, and delta:Y times V isomorphic to d disjoint copies of V over V (def-pc-fibre-product), there is gamma:Y times Spec S isomorphic to D(phi(g)) in Spec of the product indexed by Fin d of S[T]/(T-phi(g)), over Spec S. Spectra use def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions. No point, etaleness or positivity hypothesis is needed for this transport.

source.place: Tag 0EYG, off-divisor branch; standard localization and degree-one root algebra calculation

proof.text: Transport the pullback and each coproduct summand along e; the compatibility equations preserve the second projection. Evaluation T at phi(g) identifies each degree-one adjoin-root algebra with S over S. Spec of the finite product is the coproduct of spectra, including the empty-index zero-ring case. The image of the unit phi(g) is a unit, making the basic open the entire product spectrum. Compose these isomorphisms; all commute with the structure map.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EYG off-divisor branch, specialized to the supplied root splitting

theorem root_split_away_transport_chart
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (n : ℕ) {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec R) (d : ℕ) (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : R →+* S)
    (hunit : IsUnit (φ g)) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (e : Spec S ≅ V.toScheme),
      e.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) →
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ _k : Fin d,
      AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ (1 : ℕ) - Polynomial.C (φ g))))
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap S (∀ _k : Fin d,
        AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ (1 : ℕ) - Polynomial.C (φ g)))))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
      (algebraMap S (∀ _k : Fin d,
        AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ (1 : ℕ) - Polynomial.C (φ g))) (φ g))
    ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ≅ V.toScheme,
      γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
